head: codex/5788-lockfile-preservation
title: [v0.91.8][tooling][lockfile] Preserve Cargo.lock during validation
body:
Closes #5788

## Summary
- routes owner-binary builds through one dependency-stable Cargo validation boundary
- requires `--locked` unless an explicit dependency-update mode is selected
- restores validation-created tracked `Cargo.lock` drift to exact pre-invocation bytes while preserving caller-owned dirty bytes
- limits the default owner-binary inventory to current operational binaries and removes duplicate nested broad validation

## Validation
- `bash adl/tools/test_owner_binary_install.sh`
- `bash adl/tools/test_run_cargo_validation.sh`
- `bash adl/tools/test_owner_validation_lane.sh`
- shell syntax and `git diff --check`
- zero tracked `Cargo.lock` changes

## Review
Exact six-script review passed with zero blockers; all five earlier findings are fixed. `REVIEW.md` and the canonical review handoff are intentionally excluded because they belong to WP-19.
